q: and they did have light continually, whether it was above the water or under the water.

s: wind blows towards promised land (during the voyage across the great waters)
q: And it came to pass that the wind did never cease to blow towards the promised land while they were upon the waters;

s: bringing them across the great deep lasts three hundred and forty and four days (upon the water)
q: And thus they were driven forth, three hundred and forty and four days upon the water

s: bringing them across the great deep is a voyage (upon the water)
q: And thus they were driven forth, three hundred and forty and four days upon the water

s: landing in the promised land occurs in promised land (on its shore)
q: And they did land upon the shore of the promised land.

s: people number about twenty and two souls (friends of Jared and his brother)
q: And the friends of Jared and his brother were in number about twenty and two souls;

s: people are taught to walk humbly before the Lord
q: And they were taught to walk humbly before the Lord; and they were also taught from on high.

s: people multiply many (upon the face of the land)
q: And it came to pass that they began to spread upon the face of the land, and to multiply and to till the earth;

s: people are strong strong (in the land)
q: and they did wax strong in the land.

s: Jared has sons four
q: And Jared had four sons; and they were called Jacom, and Gilgah, and Mahah, and Orihah.

s: people desire anointing a king (before Jared and the brother of Jared died)
q: And it came to pass that the people desired of them that they should anoint one of their sons to be a king over them.

s: anointing a king is desired by people (to establish a king over them)
q: And it came to pass that the people desired of them that they should anoint one of their sons to be a king over them.

s: kingship leads to captivity (according to the brother of Jared)
q: Surely this thing leadeth into captivity.

s: Pagag refuses kingship
q: And it came to pass that they chose even the firstborn of the brother of Jared; and his name was Pagag. And it came to pass that he refused and would not be their king.

s: Orihah is a king (over the people)
q: and Orihah was anointed to be king over the people.

s: Orihah walks humbly before the Lord
q: And it came to pass that Orihah did walk humbly before the Lord,

s: Orihah teaches people (the great things the Lord had done for their fathers)
q: and also taught his people how great things the Lord had done for their fathers.

s: people prosper exceedingly (under Orihah's reign)
q: And he began to reign, and the people began to prosper; and they became exceedingly rich.

s: tender mercies are received by people (during the voyage and landing)
q: they bowed themselves down upon the face of the land, and did humble themselves before the Lord, and did shed tears of joy before the Lord, because of the multitude of his tender mercies over them.

s: brother of Jared has sons and daughters twenty and two souls
q: Now the number of the sons and the daughters of the brother of Jared were twenty and two souls;

s: the Lord causes to shine small stones (to give light in darkness)
q: And thus the Lord caused stones to shine in darkness, to give light unto men, women, and children, that they might not cross the great waters in darkness.

s: small stones are in vessels or barges (one in each end)
q: the brother of Jared came down out of the mount, and he did put forth the stones into the vessels which were prepared, one in each end thereof; and behold, they did give light unto the vessels.

s: small stones give light to vessels or barges
q: and behold, they did give light unto the vessels.

s: vessels or barges are tight like unto a dish
q: their vessels being tight like unto a dish, and also they were tight like unto the ark of Noah;

s: vessels or barges are tight ark of Noah (like unto)
q: their vessels being tight like unto a dish, and also they were tight like unto the ark of Noah;

s: Orihah executes judgment judgment (in righteousness all his days)
q: And it came to pass that Orihah did execute judgment upon the land in righteousness all his days, whose days were exceedingly many.

s: Corihor has army (Corihor's army) (gathered against the land of Moron)
q: And when he had gathered together an army he came up unto the land of Moron where the king dwelt, and took him captive,

s: Corihor is parent of Noah
q: And it came to pass that Corihor had many sons and daughters. And among the sons of Corihor there was one whose name was Noah.

s: Corihor repents of wickedness (many evils he had done)
q: And Corihor repented of the many evils which he had done; wherefore Shule gave him power in his kingdom.

s: Shule is a son (of Kib)
q: nevertheless Kib begat Shule in his old age, while he was yet in captivity.

s: Shule is a king (of the kingdom of Shule)
q: therefore he began to reign in the stead of his father.

s: Shule executes judgment judgment (in righteousness)
q: And it came to pass that he did execute judgment in righteousness; and he did spread his kingdom upon all the face of the land, for the people had become exceedingly numerous.

s: Shule reigns in place of his father
q: therefore he began to reign in the stead of his father.

s: Shule gives power to Corihor (in his kingdom)
q: And Corihor repented of the many evils which he had done; wherefore Shule gave him power in his kingdom.

s: Shule has children sons and daughters (in his old age)
q: And because the people did repent of their iniquities and idolatries the Lord did spare them, and they began to prosper again in the land. And it came to pass that Shule begat sons and daughters in his old age.

s: Kib is a son (of Orihah)
q: And it came to pass that he also begat Kib in his old age.

s: Shule has no wars (during his days)
q: And there were no more wars in the days of Shule;

s: Shule remembers bringing them across the great deep (as a great thing the Lord had done for his fathers)
q: and he remembered the great things that the Lord had done for his fathers in bringing them across the great deep into the promised land;

s: Noah is a son (of Corihor)
q: And among the sons of Corihor there was one whose name was Noah.

s: Noah rebels against Shule (the king)
q: And it came to pass that Noah rebelled against Shule, the king, and also his father Corihor,

s: Noah rebels against Corihor (his father)
q: And it came to pass that Noah rebelled against Shule, the king, and also his father Corihor,

s: Noah is a king (over part of the land)
q: And he gave battle unto Shule the king, in which he did obtain the land of their first inheritance; and he became a king over that part of the land.

s: Noah is killed by sons of Shule (while Shule was captive)
q: the sons of Shule crept into the house of Noah by night and slew him,

s: Cohor is killed by Shule (in battle)
q: in which Shule did beat them and did slay Cohor.

s: Kib is a king
q: And it came to pass that Kib reigned in his stead; and Kib begat Corihor.

s: the prophets are sent by Lord (among the people)
q: And also in the reign of Shule there came prophets among the people, who were sent from the Lord,

s: the prophets prophesy the curse upon the land (because of wickedness and idolatry)
q: prophesying that the wickedness and idolatry of the people was bringing a curse upon the land,

s: the prophets have power to go whithersoever they would (under the law throughout all the land)
q: And he did execute a law throughout all the land, which gave power unto the prophets that they should go whithersoever they would;

s: people are exceedingly numerous exceedingly numerous (during Shule's reign)
q: for the people had become exceedingly numerous.

s: people repent of wickedness (and idolatries)
q: And because the people did repent of their iniquities and idolatries the Lord did spare them,

s: people prosper again in the land (after repentance)
q: and they began to prosper again in the land.

s: judgment is executed by Orihah (in righteousness all his days)
q: And it came to pass that Orihah did execute judgment upon the land in righteousness all his days, whose days were exceedingly many.

s: captivity is prophesied by Jared (as a consequence of the king being taken captive)
q: which brought to pass the saying of the brother of Jared that they would be brought into captivity.

s: Kib is in captivity (with his people under Corihor)
q: And it came to pass that Kib dwelt in captivity, and his people under Corihor his son, until he became exceedingly old; nevertheless Kib begat Shule in his old age, while he was yet in captivity.

s: rebellion is committed by Corihor (against his father)
q: And when Corihor was thirty and two years old he rebelled against his father,

s: battle is fought between Shule (and Corihor)
q: and gave battle unto his brother Corihor, by which means he obtained the kingdom and restored it unto his father Kib.

s: wickedness brings the curse upon the land (together with idolatry)
q: prophesying that the wickedness and idolatry of the people was bringing a curse upon the land,

s: idolatry brings the curse upon the land (together with wickedness)
q: prophesying that the wickedness and idolatry of the people was bringing a curse upon the land,

s: wars are absent no more (in the days of Shule)
q: And there were no more wars in the days of Shule;

s: kingdom of Shule is ruled by Shule
q: And now because of the thing which Shule had done, his father bestowed upon him the kingdom; therefore he began to reign in the stead of his father.

s: Kib is parent of Corihor
q: And it came to pass that Kib reigned in his stead; and Kib begat Corihor.

s: Kib is parent of Shule (in his old age)
q: nevertheless Kib begat Shule in his old age, while he was yet in captivity.

s: Corihor is a son (of Kib)
q: And it came to pass that Kib reigned in his stead; and Kib begat Corihor.

s: Corihor is in land of Nehor (after rebelling against his father)
q: And when Corihor was thirty and two years old he rebelled against his father, and went over and dwelt in the land of Nehor;

s: Corihor has children sons and daughters (exceedingly fair)
q: and he begat sons and daughters, and they became exceedingly fair; wherefore Corihor drew away many people after him.

s: Omer is a person
q: And it came to pass that he begat Omer, and Omer reigned in his stead.

s: Jared dwells in land of Heth (after rebelling against his father)
q: And Jared rebelled against his father, and came and dwelt in the land of Heth.

s: Jared has Jared's rebellion
q: And Jared rebelled against his father, and came and dwelt in the land of Heth.

s: Jared controls kingdom (half of the kingdom)
q: And it came to pass that he did flatter many people, because of his cunning words, until he had gained the half of the kingdom.

s: Jared is sorrowful sorrow (because of losing the kingdom)
q: now Jared became exceedingly sorrowful because of the loss of the kingdom, for he had set his heart upon the kingdom and upon the glory of the world.

s: Jared desires kingdom (with his heart set upon it)
q: now Jared became exceedingly sorrowful because of the loss of the kingdom, for he had set his heart upon the kingdom and upon the glory of the world.

s: Jared desires glory (of the world)
q: now Jared became exceedingly sorrowful because of the loss of the kingdom, for he had set his heart upon the kingdom and upon the glory of the world.

s: Esrom is child of Omer
q: And it came to pass that he begat sons and daughters among whom were Esrom and Coriantumr;
